deities: Lord Ganesha (Prasanna Ganapathi, ~6 m monolithic murti)

history.dynasty: Chitradurga Nayakas (founded 1475 CE by Guthyappa Nayaka)
history.period: 1475 CE per Wikipedia/Velpu (one source gives 1775, likely a transcription error - CONFLICT (verify))
history.summary: Ganesha temple at Holalkere founded in 1475 CE by Guthyappa Nayaka, enshrining a ~6-metre (20 ft) monolithic black-stone Ganesha murti worshipped as Prasanna Ganapathi. Local legend holds that sincere worship here fulfils wishes. Also known as the Bayalu (open-air) Ganapathi temple; it has a three-tier rajagopuram and a dwajasthamba inside. Founding date CONFLICT (verify): Wikipedia and Velpu say 1475 AD; one other source says 1775.

name: Holalkere Ganesha Temple
town_description: CSV town 'Chitradurga' corrected: the temple is in Holalkere, a town and taluk headquarters in Chitradurga district, about 30-34 km from Chitradurga. It sits at ~710 m elevation with PIN 577526. Beyond the Ganesha temple, Holalkere is known for the Leela Visranti Dhama (burial site of a Murugha matha seer) and the Ontikallu matha nearby. It is a Kannada-speaking agricultural town with its own railway station.

travel.airport: Mangaluru International Airport ~295 km (verify); Hubballi Airport ~200 km (verify)
travel.road: Holalkere bus stand ~700 m from temple; ~34 km by road from Chitradurga via KSRTC buses
